meta.what: IRP 2025 Moderate electricity demand forecast, TWh, digitised from Figure 2 'Electricity Demand Forecast and Sensitivities' (Integrated Resource Plan 2025, p.11; Government Gazette No. 53596, 28 October 2025, p.22). IRP 2025 publishes no table; its full forecasting report is not public (searched 24 Oct 2026).
meta.definition: IRP 2025 p.11: historical consumption of all systems connected to the transmission and distribution grid, excluding pumping of pumped-storage stations, battery charging and power stations' auxiliaries, including network losses; the forecast covers deemed sales across the borders (p.11 input assumptions). Its 2024 value (238.3) matches ESRG's Mode 1 total (domestic grid, exports, distributed PV and other onsite generation, 239.2), the basis the conversion in gen_irp_index.py assumes.
meta.method: harness/pathway/digitise_irp2025_fig2.py: the raster embedded in the gazette PDF, axes calibrated from its tick marks (1 px = 1.04 TWh, one year = 21.7 px), the line found by colour and traced row by row, each year a straight-line fit over +/-0.5 year; to 2030 all lines but Low Delayed EVs coincide, to 2033.5 High and Moderate run together (High = Moderate to 2032, p.12). Reading error: about +/-1 TWh where read (fit residual 0.1-0.3 TWh plus calibration), +/-3 TWh where interpolated.
meta.checks: 2029 reads 255.0 TWh, the plan's 'about 255 TWh by 2029' (p.34; the executive summary says 2030, where the figure reads 260.0); growth 2024-2040 2.2% a year against the plan's 2.3% average.
meta.source: IRP 2025 (Department of Electricity and Energy), public; digitised by GridTwin ZA, 24 Oct 2026
